title: The Night of Edition 003
note: Line 1 is the event's fixture (fixtures/haunted-dashboard.json, raw_incident_stream only). The rest are our own incident stream.

presets.label: 👻 Level-5 phantom
presets.tip: The event's own fixture: a level-5 phantom at the coffee bar with 4 engineers pinned.
presets.text: ALERT: Reports of a level-5 Phantom apparition at the AWS Builder Loft catering sector. Entities are disrupting the local network nodes. 4 engineers are currently pinned behind the coffee bar. Ambient temperature dropped to -4C. EMF emissions registering at 98 milligauss and climbing rapidly. Traditional security systems completely non-responsive.

presets.label: 🌫️ Fog machine?
presets.tip: A false alarm. Watch the station stay calm and explain why.
presets.text: uh hi, someone in the lounge says there's a ghost?? it's misty and green. EMF meter says 2 mG, temp 22C. pretty sure the DJ just turned on the fog machine and the green lasers lol

presets.label: 🔌 Network poltergeist
presets.tip: A haunting in the server rack. Brings up the network panel.
presets.text: Server rack in the network closet is rebooting itself every 40s. Knocking sounds inside the rack, EMF 61 mG, cold spot 9C right at the patch panel. 7 of 12 switches flapping. Nobody inside, door locked.

night: ALERT: Reports of a level-5 Phantom apparition at the AWS Builder Loft catering sector. Entities are disrupting the local network nodes. 4 engineers are currently pinned behind the coffee bar. Ambient temperature dropped to -4C. EMF emissions registering at 98 milligauss and climbing rapidly. Traditional security systems completely non-responsive.
UPDATE 21:07 - EMF now 131 mG. Phantom drifting from the coffee bar toward the main stage. Temp -7C. Engineers still pinned, one is reciting the AWS shared responsibility model to calm it down.
UPDATE 21:12 - Salt line holding at the coffee bar entrance. 2 of the 4 engineers crawled out through the workshop door. EMF dropping to 74 mG. Main stage sealed.
UPDATE 21:20 - All 4 engineers out and safe in the lounge. EMF 9 mG and falling, temperature back to 17C. Residual echo near the espresso machine, low confidence.
